content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating "The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions may require a written change order.", you are required to provide up to 15 rounds of revisions, which is an excessive number that can trap you in endless rework without additional compensation. I suggest changing this so that the parties agree to include up to two rounds of revisions for each principal Deliverable, with additional revisions performed pursuant to a written change order at the Contractor's standard hourly rates. - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 60. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.", payment is due in 60 days, which forces you to wait too long to receive your money. I suggest updating the terms so that invoices are payable Net 30. - Regarding the clause stating "Revision allowance: 15 rounds", you are required to provide up to 15 rounds of revisions, which is an excessive amount of work that can trap you in endless changes without additional pay. I propose updating the revision allowance to 3 rounds. - Regarding the clause stating "Payment period: Net 60", you will be paid within 60 days after invoicing, which forces you to wait two months for your money and creates cash flow risks. I propose changing the payment period to Net 30. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
